preconditions.description: The length of the text string txt must be between 1 and 100,000.
The length of the pattern string pat must be greater than 0 and less than the length of txt.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(i, int) and i >= 1 for i in return_value)
postconditions.description: All elements in the returned list must be integers representing valid 1-based starting indices of occurrences of pat in txt.

postconditions.expression: len(return_value) == sum(1 for i in range(len(txt) - len(pat) + 1) if txt[i:i+len(pat)] == pat)
postconditions.description: The number of elements in the returned list must equal the number of times pat occurs as a substring in txt.

postconditions.expression: return_value == [] if not any(txt[i:i+len(pat)] == pat for i in range(len(txt) - len(pat) + 1)) else True
postconditions.description: If pat does not occur in txt, the returned list must be empty; otherwise, it must contain valid starting indices.
